description: Revoke a public link of a matrix: the page stops opening at once, for everyone who has the link. It cannot be undone; a new share_matrix makes a new link. Take share_id from list_matrix_shares. Not available in local JSON mode.

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix (default: the default matrix of the organization)

share_id.description: UUID of the link to revoke, from list_matrix_shares

name: revoke_matrix_share
title: Revoke a public link
